text: Draft writers put a '## Writer notes' section in the page file and publish.py drafts does not strip it, so the notes would reach the WordPress draft. Also: review.py sheet counts Fix rows as 'fixed silently' before review.py apply has run.

text: review.py apply crashes (ValueError in LETTERS.index) when a row's 'recommended' is an uppercase letter (pilot drafts row 1 had 'A'); defaults are not lowercased before lookup.
